body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2024-07-30 (Q1FY25 concall transcript): "you can expect some moderate growth in the overall debt number in line with the overall top line of the company" Metric: Gross borrowings. Target: growth <= revenue growth. Deadline: 2025-03-31. Specificity: vague; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: delivered. Evidence: Borrowings Mar-24 592 -> Mar-25 711 cr (+20%) vs revenue +41% (screener). Company: net debt incl. acceptances fell INR 111 cr to 1,016 cr.
